statement: The product shall be named gsnv-paint.
procedure: Inspect application title, package name, README, and release manifest; assert the product name is gsnv-paint.

statement: The product shall contain Image, Video, and CAD workspaces in one application window.
procedure: Switch through all three workspaces; assert each is hosted by the same shell and document context is retained.

statement: The implementation shall be greenfield and shall not clone, read, or port code from another Goosnav repository.
procedure: Inspect the source provenance and dependency record plus repository-operation log; assert no other Goosnav repository supplied implementation code.

statement: The product shall implement only the daily-use functions enumerated by the user, with no additions outside that scope.
procedure: Compare exposed commands and planned bricks against this baseline and the explicit exclusions; every command must have an in-scope requirement.

statement: The phase plan shall prioritize CAD over Image and Video, reducing Video first if a capacity tradeoff is required.
procedure: Inspect phase order and any scope decision; assert CAD precedes Image and Video and any proposed reduction names Video first without silently deleting requirements.

statement: All editing, geometry, pixel, timeline, codec, and file-processing logic shall execute client-side.
procedure: Exercise representative CAD, Image, and Video edits with network interception; assert processing completes without a backend request, then inspect runtime boundaries.

statement: The product shall require no account.
procedure: Launch a clean profile offline after installation; open and edit each workspace without login, registration, or identity prompts.

statement: The product shall send no telemetry.
procedure: Record every network request while opening files, editing, saving, and exporting in all workspaces; assert no telemetry request or beacon occurs.

statement: The product shall upload no user project or source-media data.
procedure: Use distinctive fixture bytes and record network traffic during all import, edit, save, and export paths; assert no user bytes leave the client.

statement: The product shall work offline after its first successful load.
procedure: Load the complete app once, disable network, close and reopen it, then create, edit, reopen, and export one document per workspace; assert no required asset is missing.

statement: The browser and local shells shall serve the same static build.
procedure: Compare per-file hashes of the web build and local ZIP static payload; assert equality excluding shell-only launcher and manifest files.

statement: The browser shell shall deploy to Cloudflare Pages.
procedure: Build the static artifact and inspect the Pages deployment configuration; smoke-test the deployed origin when credentials permit and record the actual origin.

statement: The supported browser target shall be current desktop Chromium at a viewport of at least 1280 by 720 pixels.
procedure: Record Chromium version and run the workspace smoke suite at exactly 1280 by 720; assert essential tools, dialogs, and status remain usable.

statement: On other browsers, the product shall state missing capabilities in the UI rather than silently failing.
procedure: Inject unsupported file-system, codec, WebGL, and WASM-thread capability results; assert a readable capability message names each unavailable operation.

statement: Geometry, pixel, and timeline logic shall be UI-free CORE modules.
procedure: Inspect CORE imports and module contracts; assert no DOM, Canvas, WebGL, codec, file-access, or shell dependency is imported.

statement: Canvas, WebGL, codecs, and file access shall reside in SHELL adapters.
procedure: Inspect the module map and import graph; assert each browser/platform API is owned by a named SHELL adapter.

statement: The shell shall use an original Windows XP-inspired web application interface with blue application navigation, lightly beveled buttons, a menu bar, icon toolbars, a left tool palette, right docked panels, a status bar and modal dialogs, without simulated OS taskbars, desktop framing or window-management controls.
procedure: Capture every workspace at 1280 by 720 and compare application navigation, menus, toolbars, tools, panels, status and dialogs against the approved web-interface checklist; verify no simulated OS taskbar, window-management controls or desktop frame.

statement: The UI font stack shall use a Tahoma-style desktop appearance.
procedure: Inspect the declared font stack and computed UI font; assert Tahoma or its documented metric-compatible fallback is applied to menus, panels, tooltips, and dialogs.

statement: The shell shall keep chrome and interaction conventions identical while swapping menus, toolbars, and panels for the selected workspace.
procedure: Switch Image to Video to CAD to Image; assert shell layout and control behavior are shared while each workspace exposes its own relevant commands.

statement: Every tool shall have an original icon.
procedure: Enumerate registered tools and inspect each icon asset; assert each tool resolves to an app-authored graphic with recorded provenance.

statement: Every tool shall have a tooltip containing its shortcut.
procedure: Enumerate registered tools, hover each toolbar/palette entry, and assert its tooltip names the tool and its assigned shortcut; invoke that shortcut in the relevant context.

statement: Every active tool shall show a status-bar instruction describing what the next click does.
procedure: Activate each tool and advance its interaction states; assert every state exposes a nonempty next-click instruction matching the expected action.

statement: Every value set by dragging shall also accept typed input.
procedure: For every registered draggable value, set a known value by drag, then type an exact value; assert the resulting model uses the typed value.

statement: Every dialog that changes document content shall preview its changes live before OK.
procedure: Open each content-editing dialog, change a parameter, inspect the preview before confirmation, cancel, and assert the original document is restored; then repeat and confirm.

statement: Escape shall cancel the active tool operation or open dialog.
procedure: Start a multistep tool and edit each dialog type; press Escape and assert the pending preview is removed without adding a document mutation.

statement: Enter shall confirm the active valid operation or dialog.
procedure: Provide valid inputs to each confirmable interaction and press Enter; assert exactly one confirmed command is applied.

statement: Wheel input shall zoom at the cursor in each zoomable workspace view.
procedure: Place the cursor over a known document point and wheel in and out; assert the point remains at the same screen coordinate within one pixel.

statement: Space-drag shall pan 2D views.
procedure: In Image, CAD sketch, and Video 2D preview, hold Space and drag 100 pixels; assert the view translates by the expected amount without modifying content.

statement: Right-click shall open a context menu for the item under the cursor.
procedure: Right-click representative face, edge, sketch entity, image layer/pixel selection, timeline clip/track, and empty canvas; assert the menu target and enabled commands match the hit item.

statement: Ctrl+N shall create a new document through the active workspace new-document flow.
procedure: Press Ctrl+N in every workspace, confirm the new-document settings, and assert the new editable document has those settings.

statement: Ctrl+O shall open a supported project or source file through the active workspace flow.
procedure: Press Ctrl+O in each workspace, choose a fixture file, and assert it opens with the expected content.

statement: Ctrl+S shall save the active project to its current file, or request a destination when unsaved.
procedure: Save a new project with Ctrl+S, edit it, save again, reopen the chosen file, and assert the latest edit is present.

statement: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+X, and Ctrl+V shall copy, cut, and paste the active editable selection using workspace-appropriate semantics.
procedure: For a CAD sketch selection, Image pixel/layer selection, and Video clip selection, exercise copy/paste and cut/paste; assert copies preserve content, cut removes the source, and undo restores it.

statement: Delete shall remove the active deletable selection.
procedure: Select a sketch entity or deletable feature, image selection/layer, and timeline clip; press Delete and assert only the active target is removed.

statement: Ctrl+A shall select all eligible items in the focused editing context.
procedure: Focus CAD sketch, Image canvas, and Video timeline separately; press Ctrl+A and assert all eligible entities, pixels, or clips in that context are selected.

statement: Every document-changing action shall support undo and redo.
procedure: Enumerate the command registry and execute each command against a fixture; undo must restore the prior serialized state and redo must restore the resulting state.

statement: Undo history shall retain at least 100 steps per document.
procedure: Apply 100 distinct document edits, undo all 100, then redo all 100; assert the initial and final serialized states match their snapshots.

statement: Ctrl+Z shall undo the last document-changing action.
procedure: Apply two edits in each workspace, press Ctrl+Z once, and assert only the second edit is undone.

statement: Ctrl+Y and Ctrl+Shift+Z shall each redo an undone action.
procedure: Undo two edits in each workspace; use Ctrl+Y for one and Ctrl+Shift+Z for the other; assert both are restored in order.

statement: Each workspace shall expose a history panel showing document actions.
procedure: Apply named operations in every workspace and assert the panel lists them in order and indicates the current undo position.

statement: Each workspace shall autosave its editable document to local browser storage.
procedure: Edit each workspace, wait for the documented autosave interval, inspect its saved local record, and assert the latest committed state is included.

statement: The application shall offer crash recovery from the latest complete autosave.
procedure: Terminate a browser session after a confirmed autosave and during a later incomplete write; reopen and assert recovery offers the latest complete record without corruption.

statement: The application shall save and open real files through the browser file-system API when available.
procedure: With the API available, create a project, save to a chosen file, modify and overwrite it, then reopen it and compare editable state.

statement: The application shall provide download and file-input fallback when the file-system API is unavailable.
procedure: Disable the native file-system API, download a saved project, reopen it through a file input, and compare editable state.

statement: Every workspace shall have a versioned and documented project format.
procedure: Inspect the CAD, Image, and Video format specifications and saved fixtures; assert each carries a schema version and documents every persisted editable field.

statement: Every workspace project format shall reopen its document fully editable.
procedure: Save fixtures containing each editable entity type, reopen them in a fresh session, compare normalized editable state, and modify each persisted entity type successfully.

statement: CAD shall use a proven open-source OpenCascade-based B-rep kernel compiled to WebAssembly.
procedure: Inspect the pinned dependency, upstream provenance, compiled artifact, and spike evidence; assert the engine is OpenCascade-based B-rep WASM and successfully creates and measures a solid.

statement: CAD shall use a proven open-source 2D constraint solver.
procedure: Inspect the pinned solver, upstream provenance, and spike evidence; assert it solves a constrained rectangle and reports a contradictory constraint set.

statement: The project shall not implement its own B-rep kernel or 2D constraint solver.
procedure: Inspect the CAD dependency boundary and implementation ownership; assert geometry-kernel and constraint-solving calls delegate to the recorded upstream engines.

statement: The B-rep kernel shall execute in a worker.
procedure: Instrument a long kernel operation; assert the kernel call runs in a worker and the main thread continues to accept cancellation or navigation input.

statement: The 2D constraint solver shall execute in a worker.
procedure: Instrument a long constraint solve; assert the solve runs in a worker and the main thread continues to accept interaction.

statement: DECISIONS shall record the kernel and solver licenses and their commercial-distribution obligations.
procedure: Inspect pinned license texts and DECISIONS for both engines; assert commercial-distribution terms and required notices/source/relinking obligations are recorded without treating availability as license approval.

statement: CAD documents shall be history-based and parametric.
procedure: Build a constrained sketch and dependent extrusion, change a driving dimension, and assert the solid rebuilds from stored feature parameters.

statement: The feature tree shall list every sketch and feature in evaluation order.
procedure: Create two sketches and three dependent features; assert all five appear once in the tree in rebuild order.

statement: Editing any sketch, dimension, or feature shall rebuild every downstream dependent feature.
procedure: Edit each source category in a three-feature chain and assert downstream geometry and measured properties reflect the change.

statement: The feature tree shall provide a rollback bar.
procedure: Move rollback before the third feature of a five-feature part; assert only the prefix is evaluated and restoring the bar evaluates the full part.

statement: A feature shall be suppressible and unsuppressible.
procedure: Suppress an intermediate feature and inspect downstream status, then unsuppress it; assert the original evaluated model is restored.

statement: A feature shall be deletable with readable dependency handling.
procedure: Delete an independent feature and then attempt deletion of a depended-on feature; assert the resulting history is valid or a readable dependency decision is required.

statement: A feature shall be renameable.
procedure: Rename a feature and save/reopen; assert its name changes without changing its stable references or geometry.

statement: Features shall be reorderable only where dependencies allow.
procedure: Move an independent feature across a sibling and assert success; move a consumer before its source and assert a readable rejection without corrupting history.

statement: A failed feature shall be flagged in the tree with a readable reason.
procedure: Apply a fillet larger than the selected solid supports; assert the feature is flagged with a reason identifying the failed operation.

statement: A failed rebuild shall never silently present a stale or invalid model as the current successful result.
procedure: Break an upstream reference, rebuild, and assert the error and affected downstream states are visible and any last-good geometry is clearly identified as stale.

statement: Each CAD document shall support millimeter or inch units.
procedure: Create a 25.4 mm edge, switch document units to inch, and assert it displays as 1 inch without changing physical geometry; round-trip the document unit setting.

statement: CAD dimension fields shall accept named variables.
procedure: Define width = 40, bind a sketch or feature dimension to width, change width to 60, and assert all bound dimensions rebuild to 60.

statement: Every CAD dimension field shall accept expressions involving variables, such as width / 2.
procedure: For each registered dimension field type, enter width / 2 with width = 40; assert the resulting dimension is 20 in document units and changing width updates it.

statement: A sketch shall be creatable on each of the three default planes.
procedure: Create one sketch on XY, YZ, and XZ and assert its coordinates map to the selected plane.

statement: A sketch shall be creatable on any planar face.
procedure: Select a planar face of a rotated solid, create a sketch, and assert its plane coincides with that face.

statement: Entering a sketch shall orient the view normal to its plane.
procedure: Enter sketches on all default planes and an angled planar face; assert the camera direction is perpendicular to the sketch plane.

statement: The sketcher shall create line entities.
procedure: In an empty sketch, click (0,0) then (20,10); assert one line with those endpoints, then save/reopen and compare entity parameters.

statement: The sketcher shall create corner rectangle entities.
procedure: In an empty sketch, click (0,0) then (30,20); assert a closed four-line rectangle bounded by those corners, then save/reopen and compare entity parameters.

statement: The sketcher shall create center rectangle entities.
procedure: In an empty sketch, click center (10,10) then corner (25,20); assert a closed rectangle symmetric about (10,10), then save/reopen and compare entity parameters.

statement: The sketcher shall create circle entities.
procedure: In an empty sketch, click center (0,0) then a radius point (10,0); assert a radius-10 circle, then save/reopen and compare entity parameters.

statement: The sketcher shall create 3-point arc entities.
procedure: In an empty sketch, click (0,0), (10,10), and (20,0); assert an arc passing through all three points, then save/reopen and compare entity parameters.

statement: The sketcher shall create center-point arc entities.
procedure: In an empty sketch, click center (0,0), start (10,0), and end (0,10); assert a radius-10 quarter arc with the requested sweep, then save/reopen and compare entity parameters.

statement: The sketcher shall create tangent arc entities.
procedure: In an empty sketch, select the end of a line and click an arc endpoint; assert an arc tangent to the selected line at the shared endpoint, then save/reopen and compare entity parameters.

statement: The sketcher shall create regular polygon entities.
procedure: In an empty sketch, type 6 sides, choose center (0,0), and radius 10; assert a closed six-sided regular polygon with equal sides, then save/reopen and compare entity parameters.

statement: The sketcher shall create slot entities.
procedure: In an empty sketch, choose centers (0,0) and (20,0), then width 8; assert a closed slot with parallel sides and radius-4 semicircular ends, then save/reopen and compare entity parameters.

statement: The sketcher shall create point entities.
procedure: In an empty sketch, click (7,9); assert a point at (7,9), then save/reopen and compare entity parameters.

statement: The sketcher shall create construction line entities.
procedure: In an empty sketch, draw a line and mark it construction; assert reference geometry omitted from profile area and solid creation, then save/reopen and compare entity parameters.

statement: The sketcher shall provide trim.
procedure: Use two crossing lines; apply trim and assert removing the clicked segment preserves the other line and remaining segments.

statement: The sketcher shall provide extend.
procedure: Use a short line aimed at another line; apply extend and assert the selected line endpoint reaches the target intersection.

statement: The sketcher shall provide offset.
procedure: Use a closed 20 by 10 rectangle and distance 2; apply offset and assert the offset contour is consistently 2 units from the source.

statement: The sketcher shall provide mirror.
procedure: Use a line segment and a selected mirror axis; apply mirror and assert the copy is reflected about the axis with preserved dimensions.

statement: The sketcher shall provide corner fillet.
procedure: Use two perpendicular lines meeting at a corner and radius 3; apply corner fillet and assert the corner is replaced by a radius-3 arc tangent to both trimmed lines.

statement: The sketcher shall provide corner chamfer.
procedure: Use two perpendicular lines meeting at a corner and distance 3; apply corner chamfer and assert the corner is replaced by the requested straight chamfer.

statement: The sketcher shall provide linear pattern.
procedure: Use a circle, count 4, and pitch 10; apply linear pattern and assert four instances are equally spaced by 10 along the chosen direction.

statement: The sketcher shall provide circular pattern.
procedure: Use a circle offset from an origin, count 6, and sweep 360 degrees; apply circular pattern and assert six instances have the requested angular spacing about the chosen center.

statement: The sketcher shall provide project edges.
procedure: Use an existing solid edge crossing the active sketch plane or lying in its projection; apply project edges and assert the projected sketch edge matches the chosen geometric projection and records its reference.

statement: The sketcher shall support the horizontal constraint.
procedure: Create a sloped line; apply horizontal, solve, and assert its endpoints have equal Y within the documented solver tolerance.

statement: The sketcher shall support the vertical constraint.
procedure: Create a sloped line; apply vertical, solve, and assert its endpoints have equal X within the documented solver tolerance.

statement: The sketcher shall support the coincident constraint.
procedure: Create two distinct endpoints; apply coincident, solve, and assert their positions become equal within the documented solver tolerance.

statement: The sketcher shall support the parallel constraint.
procedure: Create two nonparallel lines; apply parallel, solve, and assert their direction vectors become parallel within the documented solver tolerance.

statement: The sketcher shall support the perpendicular constraint.
procedure: Create two oblique lines; apply perpendicular, solve, and assert their dot product becomes zero within the documented solver tolerance.

statement: The sketcher shall support the tangent constraint.
procedure: Create a line and circle; apply tangent, solve, and assert the line touches the circle with a perpendicular radius at contact within the documented solver tolerance.

statement: The sketcher shall support the concentric constraint.
procedure: Create two circles; apply concentric, solve, and assert their centers become equal within the documented solver tolerance.

statement: The sketcher shall support the equal constraint.
procedure: Create two lines of different length and separately two circles of different radius; apply equal, solve, and assert line lengths or circle radii become equal within the documented solver tolerance.

statement: The sketcher shall support the collinear constraint.
procedure: Create two offset lines; apply collinear, solve, and assert both lines lie on the same infinite line within the documented solver tolerance.

statement: The sketcher shall support the midpoint constraint.
procedure: Create a point and line segment; apply midpoint, solve, and assert the point equals the average of the line endpoints within the documented solver tolerance.

statement: The sketcher shall support the symmetric constraint.
procedure: Create two points and an axis; apply symmetric, solve, and assert the points become reflections across the axis within the documented solver tolerance.

statement: The sketcher shall support the fix constraint.
procedure: Create a free entity; apply fix, solve, and assert its constrained coordinates remain unchanged when neighboring geometry is dragged within the documented solver tolerance.

statement: The sketcher shall infer applicable geometric constraints while drawing.
procedure: Draw a nearly horizontal line and snap its endpoint to an existing point; assert the inferred horizontal and coincident constraints are offered/applied according to the displayed inference.

statement: Sketch constraints shall be shown as glyphs.
procedure: Apply each supported constraint to a fixture; assert a visible, selectable glyph identifies its type and associated geometry.

statement: Sketch constraints shall be deletable.
procedure: Select a constraint glyph and delete it; assert its constraint record is removed and the released degree of freedom can move.

statement: A single dimension tool shall select linear, aligned, radius, diameter, or angle dimensions from one or two selected entities.
procedure: Use the same tool on suitable horizontal/vertical distances, an inclined line, circle/arc radius, circle diameter, and two angled lines; assert each of the five types is offered and drives geometry.

statement: Double-clicking a dimension shall edit its value.
procedure: Double-click a displayed dimension, type a new value or expression, confirm, and assert the sketch and downstream solid rebuild.

statement: The sketcher shall use distinguishable color states for under-defined, fully defined, and over-defined geometry.
procedure: Open one fixture for each solve state and assert rendered entity colors match the documented three-state legend.

statement: Under-defined sketch geometry shall be draggable within its remaining degrees of freedom.
procedure: Drag an unconstrained endpoint and a point constrained to a line; assert the first follows freely and the second stays on the line.

statement: An over-constrained sketch shall produce a flagged, readable error.
procedure: Fix a 20-unit line and impose a conflicting 30-unit length; assert a visible over-constraint error identifies the conflicting geometry or constraints and prevents silent acceptance.

statement: CAD shall support extrude boss in blind mode.
procedure: Create a closed profile and depth 12, apply extrude boss in blind mode, and assert the feature extends/cuts exactly 12 units along the selected direction using B-rep bounds and section intersections.

statement: CAD shall support extrude boss in mid-plane mode.
procedure: Create a closed profile and total depth 12, apply extrude boss in mid-plane mode, and assert the feature extends/cuts 6 units to each side of the sketch plane using B-rep bounds and section intersections.

statement: CAD shall support extrude boss in up to face mode.
procedure: Create a profile and selected planar stop face, apply extrude boss in up to face mode, and assert the feature terminates on that face and follows it after the stop face moves using B-rep bounds and section intersections.

statement: CAD shall support extrude boss in through all mode.
procedure: Create a profile crossing a body, apply extrude boss in through all mode, and assert the operation traverses the entire intersected target extent and remains through after target thickness changes using B-rep bounds and section intersections.

statement: CAD shall support extrude cut in blind mode.
procedure: Create a closed profile and depth 12, apply extrude cut in blind mode, and assert the feature extends/cuts exactly 12 units along the selected direction using B-rep bounds and section intersections.

statement: CAD shall support extrude cut in mid-plane mode.
procedure: Create a closed profile and total depth 12, apply extrude cut in mid-plane mode, and assert the feature extends/cuts 6 units to each side of the sketch plane using B-rep bounds and section intersections.

statement: CAD shall support extrude cut in up to face mode.
procedure: Create a profile and selected planar stop face, apply extrude cut in up to face mode, and assert the feature terminates on that face and follows it after the stop face moves using B-rep bounds and section intersections.

statement: CAD shall support extrude cut in through all mode.
procedure: Create a profile crossing a body, apply extrude cut in through all mode, and assert the operation traverses the entire intersected target extent and remains through after target thickness changes using B-rep bounds and section intersections.

statement: CAD shall support revolve boss.
procedure: Apply revolve boss to a rectangular profile offset from an axis and a 360-degree angle; assert a closed revolved solid with analytically expected volume, then edit its driving value and assert dependent rebuild succeeds.

statement: CAD shall support revolve cut.
procedure: Apply revolve cut to an intersecting profile, target body, and revolution axis; assert a revolved void with analytically expected removed volume, then edit its driving value and assert dependent rebuild succeeds.

statement: CAD shall support constant-radius fillet.
procedure: Apply constant-radius fillet to a rectangular prism, one edge, and radius 2; assert a valid solid with a radius-2 edge blend, then edit its driving value and assert dependent rebuild succeeds.

statement: CAD shall support chamfer.
procedure: Apply chamfer to a rectangular prism, one edge, and distance 2; assert a valid solid with the requested straight bevel, then edit its driving value and assert dependent rebuild succeeds.

statement: CAD shall support shell.
procedure: Apply shell to a box, selected opening face, and wall thickness 2; assert an open hollow solid with 2-unit walls, then edit its driving value and assert dependent rebuild succeeds.

statement: CAD shall support simple hole.
procedure: Apply simple hole to a plate, center point, diameter 6, and depth 4; assert a cylindrical void 6 units in diameter and 4 units deep, then edit its driving value and assert dependent rebuild succeeds.

statement: CAD shall support counterbore hole.
procedure: Apply counterbore hole to a plate, hole diameter/depth, counterbore diameter/depth; assert a stepped cylindrical hole matching all typed diameter and depth values, then edit its driving value and assert dependent rebuild succeeds.

statement: CAD shall support countersink hole.
procedure: Apply countersink hole to a plate, hole diameter/depth and countersink dimensions; assert a conical entrance and cylindrical hole matching typed size and depth values, then edit its driving value and assert dependent rebuild succeeds.

statement: CAD shall support linear feature pattern.
procedure: Apply linear feature pattern to a seed feature, count 4, and spacing 12; assert four features occur at the requested linear offsets, then edit its driving value and assert dependent rebuild succeeds.

statement: CAD shall support circular feature pattern.
procedure: Apply circular feature pattern to a seed feature, axis, count 6, and 360-degree sweep; assert six features occur at the requested angular offsets, then edit its driving value and assert dependent rebuild succeeds.

statement: CAD shall support feature mirror.
procedure: Apply feature mirror to a seed feature and reference plane; assert a mirrored feature lies at the reflected location, then edit its driving value and assert dependent rebuild succeeds.

statement: CAD shall create offset plane reference geometry.
procedure: Create offset plane from a base plane and distance 10; assert a parallel plane 10 units from the base, then reference it from a later feature and rebuild.

statement: CAD shall create angled plane reference geometry.
procedure: Create angled plane from a base plane, axis, and angle 30 degrees; assert a plane rotated 30 degrees about that axis, then reference it from a later feature and rebuild.

statement: CAD shall create axis reference geometry.
procedure: Create axis from selected reference geometry defining a line; assert a stable reference axis at the defined line, then reference it from a later feature and rebuild.

statement: CAD shall create point reference geometry.
procedure: Create point from selected coordinates or reference geometry defining a location; assert a stable reference point at the defined location, then reference it from a later feature and rebuild.

statement: Feature depth and distance shall be adjustable by a drag arrow in the viewport.
procedure: Select an extrude depth and reference-plane distance; drag each viewport arrow, confirm, and assert the displayed parameter and rebuilt geometry match.

statement: Feature depth and distance shall accept typed values.
procedure: Type exact values into the same extrude depth and reference-plane distance controls; assert the parameter and geometry use those exact values.

statement: Double-clicking a feature shall reveal editable dimensions in place.
procedure: Double-click a supported feature in the viewport or tree; assert its dimensions appear on the model, edit one, and verify the dependent rebuild.

statement: Middle-drag shall orbit the CAD view.
procedure: Middle-drag a known screen delta; assert camera orientation changes while the target remains fixed and document geometry is unchanged.

statement: Shift+middle-drag shall pan the CAD view.
procedure: Hold Shift and middle-drag; assert camera and target translate together without changing orientation.

statement: CAD shall provide a view cube.
procedure: Click each cube face and isometric corner; assert the corresponding standard or isometric camera orientation.

statement: CAD shall provide on-screen orbit, pan, and zoom controls usable without a middle mouse button.
procedure: Use only primary pointer and the on-screen controls to orbit, pan, and zoom; assert each changes the camera as labeled.

statement: CAD shall provide standard orthographic views.
procedure: Choose front, back, top, bottom, left, and right views; assert the expected orthogonal camera axes.

statement: CAD shall provide an isometric view.
procedure: Invoke isometric view and assert the camera has equal projected principal-axis scale with a stable up direction.

statement: F shall zoom the CAD view to fit the visible model.
procedure: Pan and zoom a model partly offscreen, press F, and assert its visible bounds fit within the viewport with a nonzero margin.

statement: CAD shall provide normal-to view for a selected planar face.
procedure: Select an angled planar face and invoke normal-to; assert the camera direction is perpendicular to that face.

statement: CAD shall select faces, edges, and vertices.
procedure: Pick a known face, edge, and vertex from a fixture; assert each selection resolves to the correct persistent topology identifier.

statement: CAD shall highlight hovered faces, edges, and vertices.
procedure: Move the pointer over one item of each topology class; assert only the hit candidate receives hover styling before selection.

statement: Ctrl shall enable multiple CAD selections.
procedure: Select a face, Ctrl-select a second, and Ctrl-select the first again; assert the selection set adds then toggles the requested item.

statement: CAD shall support box selection.
procedure: Drag a selection box around a known group of selectable entities; assert the selected set follows the displayed box-selection rule.

statement: CAD shall provide face, edge, and vertex selection filters.
procedure: Enable each filter separately and click overlapping topology; assert only the enabled topology class can be selected.

statement: CAD shall provide shaded-with-edges, shaded, wireframe, and hidden-line display modes.
procedure: Render a solid with occluded edges in all four modes and compare approved image fixtures; assert each mode displays the correct surfaces and edge visibility.

statement: CAD shall provide a section view.
procedure: Move a section plane through a hollow fixture; assert the displayed cut reveals the interior at the selected plane without changing the solid.

statement: CAD shall support per-body color.
procedure: Assign different colors to two bodies, save/reopen, and assert each body retains its color.

statement: CAD shall support per-face color.
procedure: Assign a distinct color to one face, save/reopen, and assert only that face retains the override.

statement: The CAD measure tool shall report distance.
procedure: Measure two points and two parallel faces with known separation; assert reported values match analytic distances within documented kernel tolerance.

statement: The CAD measure tool shall report angle.
procedure: Measure two edges at 30 degrees; assert the reported angle matches within documented angular tolerance.

statement: The CAD measure tool shall report radius.
procedure: Measure a radius-5 circular edge and cylindrical face; assert the radius is 5 within documented kernel tolerance.

statement: CAD mass properties shall report volume.
procedure: Measure a 10 by 20 by 30 box; assert volume is 6000 cubic document units within documented kernel tolerance.

statement: CAD mass properties shall report surface area.
procedure: Measure a 10 by 20 by 30 box; assert surface area is 2200 square document units within documented kernel tolerance.

statement: CAD mass properties shall calculate mass from user-specified density.
procedure: Assign a density of 0.002 mass units per cubic unit to a 6000-cubic-unit box; assert mass is 12 and changing density updates mass.

statement: CAD mass properties shall report center of mass.
procedure: Measure a uniform box from (0,0,0) to (10,20,30); assert center of mass is (5,10,15) within documented kernel tolerance.

statement: CAD shall export STEP.
procedure: Export a solid containing a hole and fillet to STEP; parse with an independent fixture validator and assert re-imported B-rep volume and topology-validity match within documented exchange tolerance.

statement: CAD shall export STL.
procedure: Export a solid with planar and curved faces to STL; parse with an independent fixture validator and assert the mesh has correct units, closed manifold topology, outward winding, and tessellation error within the chosen export tolerance.

statement: CAD shall export 3MF.
procedure: Export a solid with two colored bodies to 3MF; parse with an independent fixture validator and assert the file parses as 3MF and contains correctly scaled closed meshes with the exported body information.

statement: CAD shall import STEP as a non-parametric solid.
procedure: Import a STEP fixture containing a valid solid; assert geometry and mass properties match the fixture and the feature tree contains an imported solid rather than invented source features.

statement: CAD shall export a sketch as DXF.
procedure: Export a sketch containing lines, circles, arcs, and construction geometry; parse the DXF and compare included geometry, units, and coordinates to the documented export policy.

statement: CAD shall export a planar face as DXF.
procedure: Export a planar face with an inner loop; parse the DXF and assert the outer and hole contours preserve coordinates and units.

statement: CAD shall provide a drawing sheet with front, top, right, and isometric views.
procedure: Generate a sheet for an asymmetric part; assert all four labeled views match the model orientation and scale.

statement: CAD drawing sheets shall include dimensions.
procedure: Place linear, diameter/radius, and angular dimensions on eligible drawing geometry; assert dimension values match the model and update after a parameter rebuild.

statement: CAD shall export the drawing sheet as PDF.
procedure: Export a dimensioned four-view sheet, render the PDF independently, and assert page size, all views, dimension text, and linework match the sheet.

statement: The CAD acceptance plate shall have volume 56654.425 mm3 within 0.01 percent.
procedure: Model a 100 by 60 by 10 mm plate; fillet the four vertical corner edges R5; cut four diameter-6 through holes with each center 10 mm from its two neighboring edges; cut a centered 20 by 20 pocket 5 deep; assert B-rep volume differs from 56654.425 mm3 by no more than 5.6654425 mm3.

statement: Changing the acceptance plate length from 100 to 120 mm shall rebuild to volume 68654.425 mm3 within 0.01 percent.
procedure: Change only the length-driving dimension from 100 to 120; rebuild dependent corner, edge-offset hole, and centered-pocket features; assert B-rep volume differs from 68654.425 mm3 by no more than 6.8654425 mm3.

statement: STEP export and re-import of the acceptance plate shall preserve its volume.
procedure: Export the rebuilt 120 by 60 acceptance plate to STEP, re-import as a new non-parametric solid, and assert volume matches the pre-export B-rep within the documented exchange tolerance and remains within the acceptance-volume tolerance.

statement: Image shall create a document with a typed width and height.
procedure: Create a 320 by 200 document and assert its pixel buffer and exported dimensions are exactly 320 by 200.

statement: Image shall create a document with a chosen background, including transparency.
procedure: Create transparent and solid-color documents; assert all initial pixels have the chosen RGBA values.

statement: Image shall paste an image from the clipboard.
procedure: Put a known 16 by 12 RGBA fixture on the clipboard, paste it, and assert its dimensions and pixels appear in an editable layer.

statement: Image shall open supported image files by drag and drop.
procedure: Drop a supported image fixture on the canvas; assert its decoded content opens using the documented new-document or new-layer flow.

statement: Image shall open PNG files.
procedure: Open a valid PNG fixture with known dimensions and reference decoded pixels; assert dimensions, orientation, and pixels match the fixture decoding policy, with an explicit documented frame policy for GIF.

statement: Image shall open JPEG files.
procedure: Open a valid JPEG fixture with known dimensions and reference decoded pixels; assert dimensions, orientation, and pixels match the fixture decoding policy, with an explicit documented frame policy for GIF.

statement: Image shall open WebP files.
procedure: Open a valid WebP fixture with known dimensions and reference decoded pixels; assert dimensions, orientation, and pixels match the fixture decoding policy, with an explicit documented frame policy for GIF.

statement: Image shall open GIF files.
procedure: Open a valid GIF fixture with known dimensions and reference decoded pixels; assert dimensions, orientation, and pixels match the fixture decoding policy, with an explicit documented frame policy for GIF.

statement: Image shall open BMP files.
procedure: Open a valid BMP fixture with known dimensions and reference decoded pixels; assert dimensions, orientation, and pixels match the fixture decoding policy, with an explicit documented frame policy for GIF.

statement: Image shall export PNG with alpha.
procedure: Export an image containing opaque, semitransparent, and fully transparent pixels; decode the PNG and assert RGBA values are preserved.

statement: Image shall export JPEG with a selectable quality.
procedure: Export a photographic fixture at two quality values, decode both, and assert dimensions and chosen alpha-flattening policy; assert the encoder receives each selected quality.

statement: Image shall export WebP.
procedure: Export and decode an RGBA fixture as WebP; assert dimensions, supported alpha behavior, and output format match the chosen export settings.

statement: Image zoom shall range from 1 percent through 6400 percent.
procedure: Set 1, 100, and 6400 percent using typed controls and wheel to each boundary; assert valid scales and clamped out-of-range values.

statement: Image shall show a pixel grid at high zoom.
procedure: Zoom an 8 by 8 fixture to the documented pixel-grid threshold and above; assert grid boundaries align with individual pixels without modifying image content.

statement: Image shall provide rulers.
procedure: Show rulers on a known-size document and pan/zoom; assert tick positions track document pixel coordinates.

statement: Image shall provide guides.
procedure: Create, move, type-position, and delete horizontal and vertical guides; assert their document coordinates persist through pan/zoom and save/reopen.

statement: Image shall provide a configurable grid.
procedure: Set grid spacing to 10 pixels and show it; assert grid lines align every 10 document pixels through pan/zoom.

statement: Image shall support snapping to guides and grid.
procedure: Move a layer or shape endpoint close to a 10-pixel grid line and guide with snapping enabled, then disabled; assert snapping occurs only when enabled within the documented tolerance.

statement: The pencil shall draw hard-edged individual pixels.
procedure: Draw a diagonal pencil stroke on a transparent 16 by 16 image with a 1-pixel tip; assert changed pixels have the exact foreground RGBA and no antialiasing fringe.

statement: The brush shall support size, hardness, opacity, flow, and stroke smoothing.
procedure: Render fixed-path strokes varying each parameter independently; assert footprint follows size, falloff follows hardness, accumulated alpha follows opacity/flow, and smoothing reduces path jitter without changing endpoints.

statement: Image shall provide an eraser.
procedure: Erase a stroke through opaque and semitransparent pixels on an unlocked layer; assert alpha is removed according to the tip settings and other layers are unchanged.

statement: Image shall provide clone stamp with a user-selected source.
procedure: Choose a source point in a distinctive pattern and paint elsewhere; assert destination pixels copy the corresponding source offset according to brush settings.

statement: Pen pressure shall drive brush size and opacity.
procedure: Replay identical pointer paths with pressure 0.25, 0.5, and 1.0; assert configured size and opacity increase with pressure and non-pressure pointers use the documented default.

statement: Fill bucket shall support tolerance.
procedure: Fill a fixture containing neighboring color differences just below and above a chosen tolerance; assert inclusion follows that tolerance.

statement: Fill bucket shall support contiguous and noncontiguous filling.
procedure: Use two disconnected regions of the same color; assert contiguous fill changes only the seed region and noncontiguous fill changes both.

statement: Fill bucket shall support sampling all layers.
procedure: Put a boundary on an upper layer and fill a lower layer with sample-all-layers on and off; assert the sampled boundary changes the region while writes remain on the active layer.

statement: Image shall provide a linear gradient.
procedure: Apply a black-to-white gradient from x=0 to x=10; assert endpoint colors and intermediate RGBA values match the documented interpolation.

statement: Image shall provide a radial gradient.
procedure: Apply a center-to-edge gradient on a known circle; assert equal-radius pixels have equal interpolated colors and endpoints match the chosen colors.

statement: Image shall provide an eyedropper.
procedure: Sample a known RGBA pixel from the configured layer/composite source; assert the foreground color matches the sampled value.

statement: Image shall draw line shapes with typed stroke width and fill settings.
procedure: Draw a line with stroke width 3 and a distinct fill, then with fill disabled; compare raster pixels to an independently generated fixture and assert typed values match previewed geometry.

statement: Image shall draw rectangle shapes with typed stroke width and fill settings.
procedure: Draw a rectangle with stroke width 3 and a distinct fill, then with fill disabled; compare raster pixels to an independently generated fixture and assert typed values match previewed geometry.

statement: Image shall draw rounded rectangle shapes with typed stroke width and fill settings.
procedure: Draw a rounded rectangle with stroke width 3 and a distinct fill, then with fill disabled; compare raster pixels to an independently generated fixture and assert typed values match previewed geometry.

statement: Image shall draw ellipse shapes with typed stroke width and fill settings.
procedure: Draw a ellipse with stroke width 3 and a distinct fill, then with fill disabled; compare raster pixels to an independently generated fixture and assert typed values match previewed geometry.

statement: Image shall draw polygon shapes with typed stroke width and fill settings.
procedure: Draw a polygon with stroke width 3 and a distinct fill, then with fill disabled; compare raster pixels to an independently generated fixture and assert typed values match previewed geometry.

statement: Image text shall support font, size, bold, italic, and alignment.
procedure: Create text with a bundled test font and vary each option, including left/center/right alignment; assert text properties and deterministic rendered bounds reflect each setting.

statement: Image text shall remain editable until rasterized.
procedure: Create text, save/reopen, edit its characters and font size, then rasterize; assert editing works before rasterization and rasterization preserves the rendered pixels.

statement: Image shall provide a move tool.
procedure: Move a selected layer by drag and typed offsets (12,-4); assert pixels move by exactly that document-space offset.

statement: Image shall provide a crop tool.
procedure: Crop a 100 by 80 image to rectangle (10,15,50,40); assert document bounds become 50 by 40 and retained pixels correspond to the requested region.

statement: Image shall provide a hand tool.
procedure: Drag the view with the hand tool; assert the camera changes while document pixels and layer coordinates remain unchanged.

statement: Image shall provide a zoom tool.
procedure: Click and type zoom with the zoom tool; assert the requested view scale is applied around the target without editing pixels.

statement: Image shall expose foreground and background colors.
procedure: Set distinct foreground and background colors and use a drawing tool and two-color gradient; assert each uses the intended color slot.

statement: X shall swap foreground and background colors.
procedure: Set foreground red and background blue, press X, and assert the two color values exchange.

statement: D shall reset foreground and background colors to their documented defaults.
procedure: Set both colors to nondefault values, press D, and assert the displayed and internal colors equal the documented reset values.

statement: The color picker shall support HSV, RGB, and hexadecimal values.
procedure: Enter equivalent red values via HSV, RGB, and hex controls; assert the same canonical RGBA color and synchronized controls.

statement: Image shall provide a color palette.
procedure: Choose two palette swatches and assert foreground color updates to the selected swatch value.

statement: Image shall provide recent colors.
procedure: Use three distinct colors, reopen the picker, and assert those colors are available in the recent-color list according to its documented ordering.

statement: Image shall support rectangle selection.
procedure: In a 32 by 24 fixture, drag from (2,3) to (10,12); assert the mask covers exactly the documented rectangular pixel bounds against an independent mask fixture.

statement: Image shall support ellipse selection.
procedure: In a 32 by 24 fixture, drag bounds (2,3,8,9); assert the mask matches the ellipse equation and edge-coverage policy against an independent mask fixture.

statement: Image shall support freehand lasso selection.
procedure: In a 32 by 24 fixture, replay a closed triangle pointer path; assert the mask covers the path interior according to the documented fill rule against an independent mask fixture.

statement: Image shall support polygon lasso selection.
procedure: In a 32 by 24 fixture, click three triangle vertices and close the polygon; assert the mask covers the polygon interior against an independent mask fixture.

statement: Image shall support magic wand selection.
procedure: In a 32 by 24 fixture, click a region with a chosen tolerance; assert the mask follows the seeded color region and tolerance against an independent mask fixture.

statement: Image shall support select by color selection.
procedure: In a 32 by 24 fixture, choose a target color and tolerance in a disconnected-color fixture; assert the mask includes matching pixels across the document against an independent mask fixture.

statement: Selection operations shall support add mode.
procedure: Combine two overlapping known rectangle masks using add; assert the resulting mask is the union including edge alpha according to the documented mask-combination rule.

statement: Selection operations shall support subtract mode.
procedure: Combine two overlapping known rectangle masks using subtract; assert the resulting mask is the initial mask minus the new region including edge alpha according to the documented mask-combination rule.

statement: Selection operations shall support intersect mode.
procedure: Combine two overlapping known rectangle masks using intersect; assert the resulting mask is the intersection including edge alpha according to the documented mask-combination rule.

statement: Image shall provide selection feather.
procedure: On an independently defined mask fixture, feather a hard-edged rectangle by radius 3; assert edge alpha follows the documented blur kernel and the selected extent changes as specified.

statement: Image shall provide selection grow.
procedure: On an independently defined mask fixture, grow a rectangle by 2 pixels; assert the binary mask expands by the documented morphological distance.

statement: Image shall provide selection shrink.
procedure: On an independently defined mask fixture, shrink a rectangle by 2 pixels; assert the binary mask contracts by the documented morphological distance.

statement: Image shall provide selection invert.
procedure: On an independently defined mask fixture, invert an arbitrary alpha selection mask; assert each resulting mask value equals 255 minus its prior value.

statement: Image shall provide selection all.
procedure: On an independently defined mask fixture, select all on a 32 by 24 document; assert every document pixel has selection alpha 255.

statement: Image shall provide selection none.
procedure: On an independently defined mask fixture, clear an arbitrary selection; assert the selection is explicitly empty.

statement: Free transform shall support moving, scaling, rotating, and skewing a selection.
procedure: Transform a selected asymmetric 8 by 6 pixel patch using each of the four operations with known parameters; assert only selected content changes and the output matches the specified resampling fixture.

statement: Free transform shall support moving, scaling, rotating, and skewing a layer.
procedure: Transform an asymmetric layer using each of the four operations with known parameters; assert its resulting placement and rendered pixels match the transform matrix.

statement: Free transform shall provide viewport handles.
procedure: Drag each move/scale/rotate/skew handle on a fixture; assert preview and committed transform match the displayed handle operation.

statement: Shift shall constrain free-transform operations.
procedure: Hold Shift during scale and rotation handles; assert aspect-ratio or angular constraints match the displayed rule and releasing Shift removes the constraint.

statement: Free transform shall accept typed move, scale, rotation, and skew values.
procedure: Enter translation (10,5), scale (2,1), rotation 30 degrees, and skew 10 degrees; assert the resulting transform matrix matches the typed values.

statement: Image shall flip selections or layers horizontally and vertically.
procedure: Flip an asymmetric fixture in each axis for both a selection and whole layer; assert exact expected pixel coordinates.

statement: Image shall rotate selections or layers.
procedure: Rotate an asymmetric fixture by the offered right-angle commands and a typed arbitrary angle; assert bounds, pixels, and resampling follow the chosen angle.

statement: Image layers shall support add.
procedure: Add a layer; assert it is a distinct transparent editable layer in the documented insertion position.

statement: Image layers shall support delete.
procedure: Delete the selected layer of a three-layer fixture; assert only that layer is removed and the resulting composite is correct.

statement: Image layers shall support duplicate.
procedure: Duplicate a layer containing pixels, mask, and properties; assert a separate editable copy preserves its content and settings.

statement: Image layers shall support reorder.
procedure: Move a layer across two other layers; assert the order and composited result change accordingly.

statement: Image layers shall support merge down.
procedure: Merge a layer into the one below; assert their visible composite is preserved within the defined blend semantics and the layer count decreases by one.

statement: Image layers shall support flatten.
procedure: Flatten a multilayer fixture; assert one raster layer remains and its pixels equal the prior document composite.

statement: Image layers shall support visibility.
procedure: Hide and show a layer; assert its composite contribution disappears and returns without changing stored pixels.

statement: Image layers shall support lock.
procedure: Lock a layer and attempt painting, transforming, and deletion through normal edit commands; assert prohibited mutations are blocked with a readable state.

statement: Image layers shall support alpha lock.
procedure: Lock alpha and paint across opaque, transparent, and semitransparent pixels; assert alpha remains unchanged while eligible color channels change.

statement: Image layers shall support opacity.
procedure: Set layer opacity to 0, 50, and 100 percent; assert composition matches the documented alpha calculation.

statement: Image layers shall support layer masks.
procedure: Create and edit a grayscale layer mask; assert masked alpha changes the composite without destroying source pixels and save/reopen preserves the mask.

statement: Image shall support the normal layer blend mode.
procedure: Composite a two-layer RGBA fixture containing black, white, midtone, and semitransparent samples using normal; assert output pixels match independently calculated channel and alpha results.

statement: Image shall support the multiply layer blend mode.
procedure: Composite a two-layer RGBA fixture containing black, white, midtone, and semitransparent samples using multiply; assert output pixels match independently calculated channel and alpha results.

statement: Image shall support the screen layer blend mode.
procedure: Composite a two-layer RGBA fixture containing black, white, midtone, and semitransparent samples using screen; assert output pixels match independently calculated channel and alpha results.

statement: Image shall support the overlay layer blend mode.
procedure: Composite a two-layer RGBA fixture containing black, white, midtone, and semitransparent samples using overlay; assert output pixels match independently calculated channel and alpha results.

statement: Image shall support the darken layer blend mode.
procedure: Composite a two-layer RGBA fixture containing black, white, midtone, and semitransparent samples using darken; assert output pixels match independently calculated channel and alpha results.

statement: Image shall support the lighten layer blend mode.
procedure: Composite a two-layer RGBA fixture containing black, white, midtone, and semitransparent samples using lighten; assert output pixels match independently calculated channel and alpha results.

statement: Image shall support the difference layer blend mode.
procedure: Composite a two-layer RGBA fixture containing black, white, midtone, and semitransparent samples using difference; assert output pixels match independently calculated channel and alpha results.

statement: Image shall provide brightness/contrast.
procedure: Apply positive and negative brightness and contrast to a grayscale ramp; assert channel outputs match the documented transfer function and clipping. Assert the operation respects the active selection and layer lock state.

statement: Image shall provide levels.
procedure: Set input black 20, white 230, gamma 1.5, and output limits on a ramp; assert exact independently calculated channel outputs. Assert the operation respects the active selection and layer lock state.

statement: Image shall provide curves.
procedure: Edit control points on a channel curve and a combined curve; assert sampled output values follow the documented interpolation with a live preview. Assert the operation respects the active selection and layer lock state.

statement: Image shall provide hue/saturation/lightness.
procedure: Apply a 120-degree hue shift and separate saturation/lightness changes to known primary colors; assert reference color-conversion outputs. Assert the operation respects the active selection and layer lock state.

statement: Image shall provide color balance.
procedure: Shift channel balance on shadows, midtones, and highlights of a fixture; assert the documented tonal weighting and clipping. Assert the operation respects the active selection and layer lock state.

statement: Image shall provide invert.
procedure: Invert a known RGBA fixture; assert each color channel becomes 255 minus its input and alpha is preserved. Assert the operation respects the active selection and layer lock state.

statement: Image shall provide desaturate.
procedure: Desaturate colored pixels; assert equal output color channels according to the documented luminance calculation and unchanged alpha. Assert the operation respects the active selection and layer lock state.

statement: Image shall provide threshold.
procedure: Apply threshold 128 to a grayscale ramp; assert pixels on each side of the documented boundary become black or white. Assert the operation respects the active selection and layer lock state.

statement: Image shall provide posterize.
procedure: Posterize a grayscale ramp to four levels; assert exactly the defined four channel values. Assert the operation respects the active selection and layer lock state.

statement: Image shall provide Gaussian blur.
procedure: Blur an impulse and hard edge with a fixed radius; assert pixels match the documented Gaussian kernel and edge handling. Assert the operation respects the active selection and layer lock state.

statement: Image shall provide sharpen.
procedure: Sharpen a fixed soft-edge fixture; assert output matches the documented kernel and clipping. Assert the operation respects the active selection and layer lock state.

statement: Image shall provide noise.
procedure: Apply noise with a recorded deterministic seed and amplitude; assert exact expected output pixels and preserved alpha policy. Assert the operation respects the active selection and layer lock state.

statement: Image shall provide pixelate.
procedure: Pixelate a 16 by 16 fixture with block size 4; assert each block matches the documented representative-color rule. Assert the operation respects the active selection and layer lock state.

statement: Color to transparency shall support tolerance and edge softness.
procedure: Remove a chosen background from a fixture with solid and antialiased edges; vary tolerance and edge softness separately and assert the alpha transition matches the documented formula without changing unrelated colors.

statement: Image resize shall support nearest-neighbor, bilinear, and bicubic resampling.
procedure: Resize a known 7 by 5 RGBA fixture to 13 by 9 with each of the three algorithms; compare every output pixel to independent expected samples.

statement: Canvas resize shall support an anchor.
procedure: Resize a 20 by 10 canvas to 30 by 20 using every offered anchor; assert source pixels shift to the expected offset and new canvas pixels use the chosen background.

statement: A scripted Image tool, layer, selection, and adjustment sequence shall produce pixel-exact golden output.
procedure: On a 32 by 24 transparent document, use a 1-pixel opaque #FF0000 pencil on points (1,1)-(12,1)-(12,8); add a layer, select rectangle (4,4)-(20,16), fill opaque #4080C0, add rectangle (16,12)-(28,20) to the selection, invert selected RGB then threshold at 128, and set the upper layer to multiply at 50 percent; compare every composite RGBA byte with a checked-in independently reviewed golden fixture.

statement: The scripted Image acceptance document shall round-trip through its project format unchanged.
procedure: Save and reopen the scripted golden document; assert canonical layer/text/mask/selection/parameter state equality and byte-for-byte equality of composite RGBA pixels; edit a retained layer afterward.

statement: Video shall provide 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1 project presets at 1080p and 4K sizes.
procedure: Create all six aspect/size combinations; assert 16:9 is 1920x1080 or 3840x2160, 9:16 is 1080x1920 or 2160x3840, and 1:1 is 1080x1080 or 2160x2160, preserving the selected preset on save/reopen.

statement: Video project frame rate shall be selectable.
procedure: Create projects at two supported frame rates including 30 fps; assert timebase, frame stepping, duration display, and export metadata use the selected rate.

statement: The media bin shall import video, audio, and still images.
procedure: Add one video, one audio, and one still-image fixture; assert each appears with the correct media type, duration where applicable, and source reference.

statement: The media bin shall show thumbnails for video, audio, and still-image items.
procedure: Import the three fixture types; assert each has an appropriate generated visual thumbnail or waveform representation tied to that item.

statement: Source media shall be read in place without loading complete large source files into memory.
procedure: Open a large fixture through a File or file handle, instrument reads and memory, and seek to distant timestamps; assert bounded ranged/chunked reads and no whole-source array-buffer allocation.

statement: Video decode shall use the browser native codec API.
procedure: Trace preview decoding of a supported video fixture; assert frames are produced through the native codec adapter rather than a server or whole-file software decoder.

statement: Video encode shall use the browser native codec API.
procedure: Trace a supported export and assert compressed audio/video packets originate from the native encoder adapter.

statement: Video shall mux encoded output with a WebAssembly muxer.
procedure: Inspect the pinned muxer artifact and trace export; assert encoded packets pass through the WASM muxer and the resulting container parses correctly.

statement: The timeline shall support multiple video tracks.
procedure: Place overlapping clips on three video tracks; assert ordering, durations, and independent track state survive save/reopen.

statement: The timeline shall support multiple audio tracks.
procedure: Place overlapping audio clips on three tracks; assert all contribute to the mix according to track state.

statement: Tracks shall support mute.
procedure: Mute one contributing audio track and a linked-media track with audio; assert their audio contribution becomes silent without moving clips.

statement: Tracks shall support solo.
procedure: Solo one track in a multitrack project; assert only the configured solo set contributes to preview/export according to the documented video/audio solo rule.

statement: Tracks shall support lock.
procedure: Lock a track and attempt clip move, trim, split, and delete; assert mutations are blocked while playback remains possible.

statement: Video and audio tracks shall support hide.
procedure: Hide and show each track type; assert the documented hide behavior is reflected in the track UI and, for video, its preview/export visibility, without changing or losing clip state.

statement: Clips shall be draggable from the media bin onto the timeline.
procedure: Drag video, audio, and still sources onto compatible tracks at known times; assert clip source and start time match the drop target.

statement: Clips shall be trimmable by dragging either edge.
procedure: Drag each edge of a clip with spare source media; assert source in/out and timeline duration change correctly without passing media bounds.

statement: S shall split a selected clip at the playhead.
procedure: Place the playhead inside a selected clip and press S; assert two clips preserve the original combined duration and contiguous source ranges.

statement: Clips shall be movable along the timeline and between compatible tracks.
procedure: Move a clip by drag and typed time, then to a second compatible track; assert source bounds and duration are preserved.

statement: The timeline shall provide ripple delete.
procedure: Delete a middle clip with ripple enabled; assert the removed duration closes according to the documented affected-track rule and linked items remain synchronized.

statement: Timeline snapping shall have an on/off toggle.
procedure: Drag a clip near another clip edge and a playhead with snapping on and off; assert snapping occurs only when enabled within the documented tolerance.

statement: Video and audio from one imported audiovisual source shall initially be linked.
procedure: Add an audiovisual source to the timeline and move/trim its video part; assert the linked audio follows with unchanged sync offset.

statement: Linked audio and video shall be unlinkable.
procedure: Unlink an audiovisual pair, move one member, and assert the other does not move.

statement: The timeline shall support markers.
procedure: Add, rename, move by typed time, and delete a marker; assert its time and name persist through save/reopen.

statement: The timeline shall support zoom.
procedure: Zoom a timeline containing clips and markers; assert screen scale changes while all timeline times remain unchanged.

statement: The timeline shall support scrubbing.
procedure: Drag the playhead to known frame times; assert preview and time display present the corresponding timeline state.

statement: Space shall toggle video playback and pause when the timeline has focus.
procedure: Press Space while paused and again while playing; assert transport changes state without adding an edit or interfering with 2D Space-drag.

statement: J, K, and L shall provide backward shuttle, stop, and forward shuttle.
procedure: Press J, K, and L from a mid-timeline position; assert backward motion, pause, and forward motion respectively with the displayed shuttle rate.

statement: Arrow keys shall step the playhead by one frame.
procedure: Press left and right arrows from frame 50 of a 30 fps project; assert positions move to frames 49 and 50 exactly.

statement: I and O shall set the timeline in and out range at the playhead.
procedure: Set I at frame 30 and O at frame 90; assert the range endpoints equal those frames and an invalid reversed range receives clear handling.

statement: Home and End shall jump to the timeline start and end.
procedure: Press Home and End in a project with a nonzero final clip end; assert playhead reaches frame zero and the documented final timeline boundary.

statement: Video clips shall support position.
procedure: Set a clip position to (100,50) and assert its composited origin follows that translation. Save/reopen and assert the editable property persists.

statement: Video clips shall support scale.
procedure: Set scale to 50 and 200 percent and assert rendered bounds scale about the documented anchor. Save/reopen and assert the editable property persists.

statement: Video clips shall support rotation.
procedure: Set rotation to 30 degrees and assert rendered orientation and bounds match the transform. Save/reopen and assert the editable property persists.

statement: Video clips shall support opacity.
procedure: Set opacity to 0, 50, and 100 percent and assert reference alpha composition. Save/reopen and assert the editable property persists.

statement: Video clips shall support crop.
procedure: Set independent crop values on all four edges and assert only the requested source region is visible. Save/reopen and assert the editable property persists.

statement: Video clips shall support speed from 0.25x through 4x.
procedure: Set speed to 0.25x, 1x, and 4x; assert source sampling and timeline duration reflect the speed and out-of-range values are rejected. Save/reopen and assert the editable property persists.

statement: Video clips shall support volume.
procedure: Set volume to zero and two known gain values; assert mixed audio amplitude follows the selected gain without changing timeline timing. Save/reopen and assert the editable property persists.

statement: Video clips shall support fade in and fade out.
procedure: Set known visual/audio fade durations and inspect samples at start, middle, and end; assert the fade envelopes match the documented curve. Save/reopen and assert the editable property persists.

statement: Video clips shall support keyframes on position with linear and ease interpolation.
procedure: Create two position keyframes at frames 0 and 30; sample frames 0, 7, 15, 23, and 30 for both linear and ease modes; assert values match the documented interpolation and endpoint values survive save/reopen.

statement: Video clips shall support keyframes on scale with linear and ease interpolation.
procedure: Create two scale keyframes at frames 0 and 30; sample frames 0, 7, 15, 23, and 30 for both linear and ease modes; assert values match the documented interpolation and endpoint values survive save/reopen.

statement: Video clips shall support keyframes on rotation with linear and ease interpolation.
procedure: Create two rotation keyframes at frames 0 and 30; sample frames 0, 7, 15, 23, and 30 for both linear and ease modes; assert values match the documented interpolation and endpoint values survive save/reopen.

statement: Video clips shall support keyframes on opacity with linear and ease interpolation.
procedure: Create two opacity keyframes at frames 0 and 30; sample frames 0, 7, 15, 23, and 30 for both linear and ease modes; assert values match the documented interpolation and endpoint values survive save/reopen.

statement: Video clips shall support keyframes on volume with linear and ease interpolation.
procedure: Create two volume keyframes at frames 0 and 30; sample frames 0, 7, 15, 23, and 30 for both linear and ease modes; assert values match the documented interpolation and endpoint values survive save/reopen.

statement: Video shall provide a cross dissolve transition.
procedure: Place distinct-color clips on either side of a 30-frame transition and compare frames at 0, 7, 15, 23, and 30; assert the two clips are mixed with complementary opacity across the overlap without changing intended timeline duration.

statement: Video shall provide a dip to black transition.
procedure: Place distinct-color clips on either side of a 30-frame transition and compare frames at 0, 7, 15, 23, and 30; assert the outgoing clip fades to black then the incoming clip fades from black without changing intended timeline duration.

statement: Video shall provide a dip to white transition.
procedure: Place distinct-color clips on either side of a 30-frame transition and compare frames at 0, 7, 15, 23, and 30; assert the outgoing clip fades to white then the incoming clip fades from white without changing intended timeline duration.

statement: Video shall provide a wipe transition.
procedure: Place distinct-color clips on either side of a 30-frame transition and compare frames at 0, 7, 15, 23, and 30; assert the selected spatial boundary reveals the incoming clip across the transition without changing intended timeline duration.

statement: Video shall provide a slide transition.
procedure: Place distinct-color clips on either side of a 30-frame transition and compare frames at 0, 7, 15, 23, and 30; assert the outgoing/incoming clips translate according to the selected direction and progress without changing intended timeline duration.

statement: Video titles shall support font, size, color, outline, shadow, and background box.
procedure: Create a title with a bundled fixture font; vary each of the six settings independently and compare rendered bounds and pixels to approved reference frames.

statement: Video titles shall support fade in and fade out.
procedure: Set title fade durations to 15 frames; assert title opacity at start, middle, steady state, and end follows the documented fade curve.

statement: Video shall provide solid-color clips.
procedure: Create a 90-frame solid clip with a chosen RGBA color; assert every untransformed preview/export frame has that color and its editable duration/color persist.

statement: Audio clips shall display waveforms.
procedure: Import an audio fixture with known silent, tone, and transient regions; assert waveform envelopes align with source times and update correctly after trim and speed changes.

statement: Video shall support detaching audio from an audiovisual clip.
procedure: Detach audio from a clip; assert an independently editable audio clip retains the original timing and source samples while the video no longer contributes duplicate audio.

statement: Video clips shall provide brightness correction.
procedure: Adjust a grayscale video fixture by a known brightness amount and compare sampled output channels to the documented function. Assert live preview and export apply the same correction parameters.

statement: Video clips shall provide contrast correction.
procedure: Adjust a grayscale video fixture by a known contrast amount and compare sampled output channels to the documented function. Assert live preview and export apply the same correction parameters.

statement: Video clips shall provide saturation correction.
procedure: Set saturation to zero and an increased value on a colored fixture; assert reference color-conversion outputs. Assert live preview and export apply the same correction parameters.

statement: Video clips shall provide temperature correction.
procedure: Apply positive and negative temperature offsets; assert the documented red/blue channel shift on reference pixels. Assert live preview and export apply the same correction parameters.

statement: Video clips shall provide blur correction.
procedure: Blur a sharp-edge video fixture with a known radius and compare sampled output to the documented kernel. Assert live preview and export apply the same correction parameters.

statement: Video clips shall provide black and white correction.
procedure: Enable black and white on a colored fixture and assert equal output color channels using the documented luminance weights. Assert live preview and export apply the same correction parameters.

statement: Video clips shall provide chroma key correction.
procedure: Key a green-screen fixture containing edge spill and a foreground subject; assert the chosen key color/tolerance removes the background while preserving the subject according to the documented key formula. Assert live preview and export apply the same correction parameters.

statement: Video preview shall maintain audio/video synchronization.
procedure: Play a 1080p30 fixture containing matching visual flashes and audio clicks; measure presented frame/audio clock offsets across playback and seek and assert they stay within one project frame.

statement: Video preview shall lower preview resolution before dropping frames under load.
procedure: Increase compositing load until full-resolution preview misses its deadline; assert the adaptive controller reduces preview resolution before deliberately skipping frames and preserves the audio clock.

statement: Video shall export MP4 with H.264 video and AAC audio.
procedure: Export a known audiovisual timeline, inspect the container with an independent parser, and assert MP4 container, H.264 video, AAC audio, and playable synchronized output.

statement: Video shall export WebM.
