procedure: Export a known audiovisual timeline, inspect the container and chosen supported codecs, and assert a valid playable WebM with correct project timing.

statement: Video exports shall use project resolution and frame rate.
procedure: Export projects with different size/rate presets; inspect encoded stream metadata and timestamps and assert dimensions and frame cadence match project settings.

statement: Video export shall provide quality presets.
procedure: Export the same timeline with every offered quality preset; assert each maps to its documented encoder configuration and produces valid output.

statement: Video export shall support the full timeline or the in/out range.
procedure: Export a six-second project both fully and with a two-to-four-second range; assert decoded content and durations match the selected boundaries within one frame.

statement: Video export shall report progress.
procedure: Export a multi-second timeline; assert progress advances monotonically from preparation through completion and reaches completion only after the output is finalized.

statement: Video export shall be cancellable.
procedure: Cancel during encode and during mux finalization; assert work stops, resources are released, and no incomplete file is reported as successful.

statement: Video shall export WAV audio.
procedure: Export a known tone and impulse timeline as WAV; assert PCM format, duration, sample rate, channels, and sample values follow the selected project audio settings.

statement: Video shall export animated GIF.
procedure: Export a short changing-color timeline as GIF; decode it independently and assert frame order, timing, dimensions, and documented palette quantization.

statement: Video shall export the current frame as PNG.
procedure: Seek to a known frame, export PNG, decode it, and assert its dimensions and pixels match the full-resolution composited frame.

statement: The automated three-clip Video acceptance timeline shall export MP4 with correct resolution and timing.
procedure: Create three clips with one dissolve, an overlaid title, and a volume keyframe; export MP4 and independently decode it; assert project dimensions, duration error no greater than one frame, and visual-flash/audio-click sync error no greater than one frame.

statement: The application shall send an Image document to the Video media bin.
procedure: Create a layered Image document with transparency, send it to Video, and assert a new still-image bin item renders the source composite at matching dimensions without a network request.

statement: The application shall send the current Video frame to Image.
procedure: Seek a Video timeline with a title and correction to a known frame, send it to Image, and assert an editable Image document contains the full-resolution composited frame pixels.

statement: The application shall send a CAD viewport capture with transparent background to Image.
procedure: Capture a colored solid from the CAD viewport and send it to Image; assert matching visible geometry and alpha zero for background pixels, with no background-color fringe.

statement: The CAD viewport shall sustain the 60 fps target on the declared reference desktop for the benchmark part.
procedure: Record machine, GPU, browser build, viewport size, and a fixed 50-feature fixture; animate orbit for a fixed 30-second interval after warmup and capture frame timestamps; assess 60 fps against the benchmark protocol, retaining trace data.

statement: A parameter change shall rebuild a 50-feature CAD part in under 2 seconds on the declared reference desktop.
procedure: Load the checked-in 50-feature parametric fixture, warm the kernel, change a driving dimension, and measure from committed parameter change to accepted final mesh; assert elapsed time is less than 2000 ms for each recorded benchmark run.

statement: The brush shall have no visible lag on a 4000 by 4000 image with 20 layers on the declared reference desktop.
procedure: Replay a fixed pressure-aware stroke on a 4000 by 4000, 20-layer fixture; record pointer-event-to-paint timing and a visual capture; obtain the user acceptance judgment for no visible lag, keeping this requirement UNTESTED until the measurable latency budget and machine are agreed.

statement: Video shall preview a 1080p30 timeline with three video tracks in real time on the declared reference desktop.
procedure: Play the fixed three-track 1080p30 benchmark for 30 seconds with audio, record presentation timestamps, resolution adaptation, dropped frames, and A/V offset; assert timeline advances in real time at 30 fps with sync within one frame under the recorded benchmark protocol.

statement: Before production code, dev/ shall contain a lean ConOps, requirements with stable IDs, and a verification plan derived from the user brief.
procedure: Inspect the first specification commit and repository history; assert all three artifacts precede implementation and every requirement has a verification entry.

statement: Before brick implementation, Mode A shall produce and commit a module map.
procedure: Inspect the map, contracts/ownership boundaries, and commit history; assert the map commit predates the first implementation brick.

statement: After the map is committed, BATCH execution shall apply to every brick in the current phase while preserving all method halt conditions.
procedure: Inspect the phase execution record; assert the user preauthorization is referenced and any triggered halt condition stops dependent implementation rather than being bypassed.

statement: Every completed implementation brick shall end GREEN while acceptance remains the user decision.
procedure: Inspect each brick receipt and its command/output evidence; assert all required checks pass and no agent self-awards user acceptance.

statement: Phase 0 shall perform reconnaissance, commit the spec suite and module map, and push them to the target repository.
procedure: Inspect Phase 0 evidence, committed tree, local commit ID, and remote branch ID; assert the pushed commit includes the reconnaissance/spec/map deliverables.

statement: Phase 1 shall complete the shell, XP chrome, shared controls, and project save/open before later workspace phases.
procedure: Inspect phase receipts and implementation commit order; assert Phase 1 scope has its own passing verification record before Phase 2 integration.

statement: Phase 2 shall spike the kernel and solver before implementing sketcher, features, inspection, exports, and drawing sheets.
procedure: Inspect the Phase 2 brick order and spike evidence; assert both engine spikes precede dependent CAD bricks.

statement: Phase 3 shall implement Image after the CAD phase.
procedure: Inspect phase receipts and commits; assert the Image phase follows the CAD phase or a user-authorized phase change is explicitly recorded.

statement: Phase 4 shall implement Video after the Image phase.
procedure: Inspect phase receipts and commits; assert the Video phase follows the Image phase or a user-authorized phase change is explicitly recorded.

statement: Phase 5 shall integrate cross-workspace actions, Cloudflare Pages configuration, and M1a packaging.
procedure: Inspect the Phase 5 receipt and artifact manifest; assert all three integration deliverables have their mapped checks.

statement: The work shall clone, build in, and push to https://github.com/goosnav/gsnv-paint.
procedure: Inspect the checkout remote URL, working tree, commits, and remote ref; assert the target repository is goosnav/gsnv-paint.

statement: Existing target-repository history and content shall be preserved.
procedure: Compare the initial remote commit and tree with the resulting history; assert the initial commit remains an ancestor and existing content has not been discarded without an authorized replacement.

statement: A push shall occur at the end of every phase only after all required phase checks are green.
procedure: For each phase receipt, compare check exit statuses, result classification, commit ID, and remote push evidence; assert required checks passed before that phase push.

statement: The workflow shall never force-push.
procedure: Inspect push commands and remote history; assert no force or lease-forced ref update was used.

statement: A push or deployment credential failure shall stop that operation and be reported.
procedure: Inject or observe a credential rejection in a controlled workflow check; assert no bypass/retry using unrelated credentials occurs and the report includes the blocked operation.

statement: Naming, copy voice, and invariants shall follow the Goosnav Comics branding skill while XP visual chrome overrides its visual chrome guidance.
procedure: Inspect displayed product copy, names, and applicable brand invariants against the recorded skill baseline; assert the documented visual override is used without importing unrelated branded assets.

statement: All shipped icons and graphics shall be original artwork drawn for this application.
procedure: Inspect the asset manifest and source artwork; assert each icon/graphic has app-specific original provenance.

statement: The application shall ship no Microsoft logos, wallpapers, sounds, or icon bitmaps.
procedure: Inspect all packaged assets and their provenance; assert none belongs to the four prohibited Microsoft asset categories.

statement: The local application shall be distributed as an M1a universal ZIP.
procedure: Inspect the ZIP layout against the productization skill manifest; extract and exercise the required launchers on each actually available OS, recording untested OS checks as untested.

statement: The local backend shall only serve static files and open the build in the browser.
procedure: Inspect server code and route behavior; assert it serves the shared static payload, opens the local browser URL, and exposes no editing, upload, account, or processing API.

statement: The local release workflow shall stop at CANDIDATE_FOR_ACCEPTANCE.
procedure: Inspect the release state and receipt; assert it is CANDIDATE_FOR_ACCEPTANCE and no final acceptance or production-release claim is made.

statement: Cloudflare Pages shall send the cross-origin isolation headers required by the chosen WASM-thread build.
procedure: Serve the Pages artifact, inspect COOP/COEP response headers, and assert window.crossOriginIsolated and the selected shared-memory worker smoke test succeed in the tested Chromium build.

statement: The current Cloudflare Pages per-file size limit shall be verified from official documentation.
procedure: Record the dated official source and documented per-file limit in DECISIONS; assert the value is evidence-backed rather than recalled.

statement: Every deployed asset shall be below the verified Cloudflare Pages per-file limit, trimming the kernel build if required.
procedure: Measure every emitted asset in bytes, compare against the recorded limit, and assert each is below it; if the kernel fails, verify a trimmed build still passes required geometry checks before deployment.

statement: Every phase-end report shall list passing, failing, and untested requirement IDs with the test command and its output.
procedure: Inspect each phase report; assert complete phase requirement classification and verbatim command/output or an explicit unavailable-check reason.

statement: Skipped or unavailable checks shall never be reported as passing.
procedure: Compare test runner statuses and environment availability with the phase report; assert every skipped/unavailable check is identified as untested or blocked.

statement: Browser and OS claims shall be limited to environments actually smoke-tested.
procedure: Compare every browser/OS support claim in the release report to recorded versioned smoke evidence; assert no untested environment is labeled tested.

statement: Every requirement shall trace to a verification procedure.
procedure: Parse requirements.json and the traceability table; assert every unique requirement has a valid parent need, module assignment, unique V-ID, method, procedure, and status.

statement: User acceptance shall use automated golden-output CAD, Image, and Video checks.
procedure: Inspect the planned and eventually implemented acceptance cases; assert they retain the prescribed plate volumes/error cases, pixel-exact Image golden/round-trip, and three-clip synchronized MP4 assertions.

statement: The CAD workspace shall exclude assemblies and mates, sweeps, lofts, draft, surfacing, sheet metal, weldments, simulation, rendering, or configurations.
procedure: Inspect the CAD command registry, UI, dependency choices, and roadmap; assert none of the enumerated out-of-scope capabilities is implemented or scheduled without a new user instruction.

statement: The Image workspace shall exclude CMYK, RAW, adjustment layers, layer styles, vector paths, generative fill, content-aware fill, or scripting.
procedure: Inspect the Image command registry, UI, dependency choices, and roadmap; assert none of the enumerated out-of-scope capabilities is implemented or scheduled without a new user instruction.

statement: The Video workspace shall exclude multicam, motion tracking, nested sequences, scopes, plugins, or automatic captions.
procedure: Inspect the Video command registry, UI, dependency choices, and roadmap; assert none of the enumerated out-of-scope capabilities is implemented or scheduled without a new user instruction.
